title: Bora Employer Pipeline Application Attempt
description: One concrete route through which a job's application was inspected or pursued (e.g. LinkedIn Easy Apply, employer ATS, recruiter-submitted route). Application-specific state (capture completeness, submission status) belongs here, not on the Job record, because one Job may have multiple distinct application routes with independently different questions and capture states.

application_attempt_id.description: Permanent unique identifier for this application attempt.

job_id.description: Job_ID of the job this attempt applies to.

source_platform.description: Application route/platform, e.g. 'LinkedIn Easy Apply', 'Employer ATS', 'Recruiter-submitted'.

source_url.description: URL of the application route when available. Null if unavailable. Must be an absolute http or https URL without embedded credentials.

created_at.description: Date this application attempt was first inspected or started.

capture_status.description: Whether all required application questions for this attempt are known to have been captured. Only explicit human confirmation may establish COMPLETE_HUMAN_CONFIRMED; completeness must never be inferred from reaching any particular screen.

attempt_status.description: EXPLORATORY: route inspected to expose mechanics/questions without intent to submit at that moment. IN_PROGRESS: real application being prepared but not submitted. SUBMITTED: application actually submitted. ABANDONED: attempt intentionally stopped.

notes.description: Optional clarifications or provenance notes. Null when no note is needed.
